description: This Java class 'ZonesLoader' loads geographic zone data from a JSON file, converts it into in-memory objects, and maps zones to countries and descriptions. It uses services for languages and countries, reads JSON data, and creates Zone and ZoneDescription objects.

classes.name: ZonesLoader
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that loads and processes zone data from a JSON resource.

methods.name: loadZones
methods.description: Loads zone data from a JSON file, processes descriptions per language and country codes, and returns a map of zone codes to Zone objects.
